Having heard yet another round of thoughtful reflections and really weighed the repeated themes—particularly the focus on how much the switch from a group to a solo trip could understandably heighten insecurity when there’s a history between the friends—I feel even firmer that this wasn’t a clear-cut, black-and-white issue.
